scoring_justification: The headline quantities are the equilibrium lattice constant, atomic coordinates, and spontaneous polarization, which are final reported results with no further recomputation possible from upstream raw artifacts; therefore a reference_match comparison against the paper's reported values with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for equilibrium lattice constant and fractional atomic coordinates from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 and Fig. 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper reporting
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own optimized values; any correct reproduction must converge to a structure close to these.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference spontaneous polarization values for PbFeO3 and PbNbO3 subcells
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Results section of the paper (polarization result)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the computed Berry-phase polarization results reported in the paper, the target of the reproduction.

required.atoms: array of objects with keys element (string), x (float), y (float), z (float)

outputs.description: Equilibrium lattice constant and relaxed atomic fractional coordinates of the PFN supercell.
Spontaneous polarization contributions of the PbFeO3 and PbNbO3 subcells computed via the Berry phase method.

output_contract.notes: The agent must install the ELK FLAPW code (http://elk.sourceforge.net) and any required numerical libraries at runtime. The workflow recreates the original WIEN2k procedure with the open-source rescoped tool; small numerical differences are expected. The electronic structure data (DOS, bands, density) are documented as process evidence but not independently scored.
